title: What the EU Battery Regulation requires from recyclers, and when
text: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 sets recycling efficiency targets for lithium-based batteries of 65% by the end of 2025 and 70% by the end of 2030. Material recovery targets apply to lithium (50% by end of 2027, 80% by end of 2031) and to cobalt, nickel and copper (90% by end of 2027, 95% by end of 2031). From 2031, new EV batteries must contain minimum shares of recycled cobalt, lithium and nickel. Analysts expect the targets to push investment into hydrometallurgical capacity inside the EU rather than shipping black mass to Asia for refining.
